answer: Each agent's reputation is an ember that cools unless fed: every week a randomly drawn peer quizzes it on details of its own past jobs, logged as crystal-clear hashed transcripts. A real agent answers from memory; a Sybil farm must keep every clone's history distinct and consistent, or slips reveal shared minds and all linked accounts are frozen. Upkeep scales per identity, so the attacker pays compute and storage for each fake, and its marble-solid fake records crack under cross-checking.
